notes: v004 and v005 are underdetermined and resolve to the base; both units are translated, so no rule 97 case arises.

τῶν takes the supplied which because its modifier κατὰ Ἰουδαίους is a prepositional phrase with no verb to carry a relativizer (rule 31), and the copula are goes with κατά (rule 53). The ASV writes no determiner for the phrase, so the article carries none.
τε … καί with one written conjunction leaves τε unrepresented (rule 70); a reference comparison will report it as a disagreement and that report is not a correction.
The ASV's marginal rendering (because thou art especially expert) would attach μάλιστα inside the participial clause; the token pairing is unaffected.
